title: Conditional κ = .003650666180757 (+0.0060797027% over #7605): main-46 final-hop merge
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**Conditional κ = 0.003650666180757.** The latest comparable peer, [#7605](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7605) at `e1d2756eecf03e146338239fee81772a99ba8d4c`, published κ `0.0036504442446`. The absolute increase is `0.000000221936157` or **+0.0060797027%**. The exact increase over its independently reproduced framework value `0.003650444244716` is `0.000000221936041` or **+0.0060796995%**. The directed proof also clears the upper endpoint of #7605’s raw crossing.

The newest higher peer claim is [#7641](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7641) at `351b09cd4b7ef8e0a24d954a761867960cbb1627`, reported κ `0.0037136318149`. It inherits #7637’s unimplemented supplier and uses 234 CLEARs. Its changed grid still needs precision and tape verification. Across those different premises the arithmetic difference is `−0.000062965634143` or **−1.6955271088%**. The new [#7640 recount](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7640) independently checks #7637’s finite word and invoice against the claimed construction.

On exact #7605, role 46 uses a direct rank-two MOVE `914→127` in place of the two rank-one hops. An 11-ADD chart-3 premix and the existing role-818 arrival restore each independent chart-245 recipient before its old read. All 74 CLEAR rows and 1,599 private-interface comparisons match. The signed [#7113](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7113) caller remains at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`. The five inherited premises remain. Maintainer-selected κ remains `0.00363005817`.

This package isolates the original-74-lifetime port and its complete replay. [#7611](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7611) extends the stay drops. [#7616](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7616) previously ported the broader edit to uncollapsed #7605 and added 39 lifetimes. Its exact construction and premise boundary differ from this isolated final-hop merge.

## Validation and reproduction

The exact source-bound word `aa83ede3e5833d43606d711068619db0dc28cbcd858dd11e8e89da6d09883916` passed complete fresh native and signed replays on CPython 3.12.14, then both stages again without bootstrap. The clean stages took 257.83 and 250.60 seconds. The checks covered exact forward/adjoint and absolute phase, all changed contact rows, 3,040 catalogue maps, 104 main boundaries and all 58 outer predicates. Corruption controls reject a missing paid MOVE, missing correction, wrong source and wrong phase. Both directed price reconstructions passed.

Paid positions `110366→110349`. Productive positions `22461` and surplus `1424` are unchanged. Ordinary upper bound `782699212→782685204`, precision `2430`, and elementary tape records `25451474528→25448575552`. The larger scalar-service allowance is included.

From repository root, run the full candidate replay. It acquires and authenticates #7605 or accepts an exact local copy with `--source-checkout`.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-main46-original-clear/replay.py --work ../main46-replay
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-main46-original-clear
```

The registered command checks package custody, independent directed price and the missing-paid-position control. The explicit replay command covers the complete native and signed stages. Hosted checks are pending at submission. Formal all-size verification and discharge of the inherited supplier premises remain open.
